info.title: Urja Meter Ops API Bridge
info.description: Clean, documented, high-performance REST API service built over the legacy Urja Meter Ops smart-meter portal. Exposes normalized meter specifications, reconstructed 7-tier electrical distribution hierarchy, interval telemetry analytics, and geospatial radius queries.

get.description: Retrieve comprehensive smart meter details including full 7-tier distribution hierarchy.
Fetch 30-minute interval smart-meter telemetry readings, total active consumption delta, voltage statistics, and automatic voltage anomaly checks.
Fetch normalized latitude and longitude coordinates for a smart meter.
Retrieve distribution transformers along with aggregated connected meter asset counts and rated capacity.

get.description: Retrieve a specific transformer installation along with the complete roster of connected smart meters.
Reconstructs and returns the full 7-tier power grid hierarchy from Zones down to individual connected smart meters (Zone -> Circle -> Division -> Subdivision -> Substation -> Feeder -> DT -> Meters).
Query a specific hierarchy entity (e.g. level='division', code='D-01') and its downstream subtree.
Performs a Haversine radial proximity search to locate smart meters within a given distance (in meters) of target latitude and longitude coordinates.
